title: Erdős-Straus Conjecture
exact_target: Can four divided by every integer at least two be written as a sum of three positive unit fractions, with repeated denominators allowed?

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, \emph{UnsolvedMath: A Curated Collection of Open Mathematics Problems}, record 1158 (NT-024). CC BY 4.0.
Eugen J. Ionascu and Andrew Wilson, \emph{On the Erd\H{o}s--Straus conjecture}, arXiv:1001.1100 (2010), abstract and Section 1.
